A SENSE OF PLACE

The Roswell
connection.

Roswell’s historic district pairs Canton Street’s restaurants and shops with notable houses and event settings nearby. It is an inviting place to linger. For a chauffeur journey, the useful detail is the precise venue and entrance, especially when guests are arriving from several hotels or residences.

TRAVEL WITH A PURPOSE

A journey for your plans.

01

Dinner on Canton Street

Choose a restaurant as the destination, then settle on a suitable pickup point for the end of the evening. If dinner is followed by another stop, discuss an hourly arrangement.

02

Guests for a private celebration

Share the event venue, guest hotel addresses and the time everyone needs to arrive. A Sprinter category may suit a shared journey, with seating and luggage needs confirmed first.

A LOCAL DETAIL
What should we provide for a Roswell event transfer?

Send the venue name and street address, guest count, departure hotel or residence, and the required arrival time. Include a return plan if guests need transport after the celebration.

Share your exact addresses, time, passengers and luggage when booking. Final availability, vehicle suitability and pricing are confirmed for the journey.
